variants.headline: Party leader blunders in election debate
variants.sub: An election debate has included a blunder by {leader}, leader of {party}.
variants.body:
The leader of {party}, {leader}, has blundered in an election debate. The misstep is established, but the words involved and their effect on voters are not supplied here. Readers assessing {target} should distinguish the debate event from a fabricated quotation or a claim that the election's outcome has been decided.

A party's principles should be strong enough to be discussed beyond an awkward performance. That does not make a leader's judgment irrelevant. Our movement should distinguish the merits of conviction from the conduct of its public presentation, rather than allowing either a blunder or a clever recovery to settle everything.

We criticise {target} in this assessment. Political leadership includes judgment under scrutiny, and a debate blunder is an appropriate occasion to question whether the standard of public presentation has been adequate. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
